description: A Late Iron Age metalled area with a large stone-lined pit. The pit and surface were associated with pottery and brooches, this lead to a ritual interpretation, and for the RSRB to mark it as a 'shrine'. During the Roman period a for would be built just to the south and the pit would be backfilled, the area becoming what appears to be animal enclosures, and later a market.
